items.name: Weather Atlas
items.shortDescription: Complete current feature scope: live weather, forecasts, radar, ten original themes, and synchronized touch/web System controls for M5Stack CoreS3. Includes firmware and all filesystem assets.

hardwareProfile.usb: USB-C native USB CDC; data cable required
hardwareProfile.flash: 16 MB flash / 8 MB PSRAM; multi-part firmware and SPIFFS package

items.authorizedUseNote: M5Stack CoreS3 only (16 MB flash / ESP32-S3); not Core, Core2, or a generic S3 board. Flash only hardware you own. Installation replaces firmware and filesystem assets. Erasing the device also removes saved Wi-Fi credentials and preferences; record your settings first.

latestRelease.assetKind: Multi-part install; this fingerprint is for the application only. Manifest and build details list all required parts.

installSteps: Use desktop Chrome or Edge on HTTPS with a USB-C data cable. Close serial monitors and other apps using the device.
Connect your M5Stack CoreS3, choose Connect & install, and select its USB serial port. Keep it connected until installation completes.
If no port appears, try another data cable or USB port. To enter download mode, hold the CoreS3 reset button for 3 seconds until the green LED lights, release it, then reconnect in the installer.
After installation, reset the device if it does not restart automatically. Open Home > System > WiFi to connect to a 2.4 GHz network.
In System > Location & Weather, enter a US ZIP or city/state and confirm the resolved place. Leave the API key blank for Open-Meteo, or supply your own AccuWeather key.
Find the device IP in System > Device & Diagnostics and open it from a browser on the same trusted network for the local control panel. Do not expose the device portal to the public internet.
